project_type: pnpm monorepo — NestJS API + React/Vite SPA + BullMQ worker + 5 shared packages
build_system: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo 2. Root package.json has turbo scripts: build, dev, lint, test, type-check. Package manager: pnpm@9.12.0. Engines: node>=20, pnpm>=9. Key quirk: packages/config must build first (upstream dependency for all tsconfigs). Use `pnpm --filter <name>` to scope commands.
test_framework: Jest 29 + ts-jest (apps/api); Vitest 2 (apps/web, packages/ui). API tests in src/**/*.spec.ts, web tests in src/**/*.test.tsx
build_command: pnpm turbo run build (from rims/ root) OR pnpm --filter @rims/<name> build
verification_instructions: 1. From rims/ root: pnpm install. 2. docker compose up -d (postgres+redis+adminer). 3. cp .env.example .env (fill real values). 4. pnpm prisma migrate dev. 5. pnpm turbo run build. 6. pnpm --filter @rims/api test && pnpm --filter @rims/web test. 7. Manual: pnpm --filter @rims/api dev + curl http://localhost:3000/api/v1/health.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/migrations/ (generated by `pnpm prisma migrate dev`). node_modules/.prisma/client/ (generated by `pnpm prisma generate`). Run `pnpm prisma generate` after schema changes before building.
environment_constraints: rims/ directory is completely empty — full scaffold from scratch. Do NOT touch any directory in the workspace root other than rims/. All file paths must be absolute or relative to /Users/macbookpro/Desktop/ProgrammoCeuticals/rims/. argon2 npm package requires C++ build tools (node-gyp); ensure build environment has them.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode everywhere. All API responses: { data: {}, meta: { requestId } }. All errors: { error: { code, message, details, requestId } }. Pagination: { data: [], meta: { total, page, pageSize, totalPages, requestId } }. Never expose stack traces to clients. All DB queries tenant-scoped. Thin controllers, business logic in services.
key_patterns: PrismaService pattern: extends PrismaClient, implements OnModuleInit/OnModuleDestroy, has .transaction() helper. See pharmacy-internship-platform/apps/api/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts. NestJS main.ts: setGlobalPrefix('api/v1'), ValidationPipe(whitelist+forbidNonWhitelisted+transform), HttpExceptionFilter, Swagger at /api/docs. See ectd/ectd-platform/apps/api/src/main.ts. Prisma schema: UUID PKs @default(uuid()), @@map snake_case, @map for columns, createdAt/updatedAt. See pharmacy-internship-platform/prisma/schema.prisma. Package names: @rims/<name> (e.g., @rims/api, @rims/web, @rims/shared-types). TanStack Query v5 + Zustand v5 + React Hook Form v7 + Zod — matches ectd/ectd-platform/apps/web/package.json. argon2@0.41.1 (not bcrypt) — matches ectd-platform api.
directory_structure:
rims/ (workspace root)
  apps/
    web/          React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind 4, port 5173
    api/          NestJS 10, port 3000, prefix /api/v1
    worker/       NestJS BullMQ worker
  packages/
    shared-types/ TypeScript enums + interfaces
    validation/   Zod schemas
    api-client/   Axios HTTP client
    ui/           React component library
    config/       tsconfig bases + eslint config
  prisma/
    schema.prisma
    migrations/
    seed.ts
    seed-data/
  docs/
    decisions/    ADR files
  infra/
    docker/
    nginx/
  .env.example
  docker-compose.yml
  package.json    pnpm workspace root
  turbo.json
  README.md
